item.title: [ransomware] Please Don’t Feed the Scattered Lapsus ShinyHunters
item.description: A prolific data ransom gang that calls itself Scattered Lapsus ShinyHunters (SLSH) has a distinctive playbook when it seeks to extort payment from victim firms: Harassing, threatening and even swatting executives and their families, all while notifying journalists and regulators… <span class="read-more"><a href="https://krebsonsecurity.com/2026/02/please-dont-feed-the-scattered-lapsus-shiny-hunters/">Read More &#187;</a></span>

item.title: [ransomware] TeamPCP’s attack spree slows, but threat escalates with ransomware pivot
item.description: <p>TeamPCP’s destructive run of supply chain breaches has stopped, for now: it has been three days since the group published malicious versions of Telnyx&#8217;s SDK on PyPI, and there haven&#8217;t been reports of new open-source project compromises. Partnership with emerging RaaS operation &#8220;The prior operational cadence was aggressive &#8211; a new target every 1-3 days (Trivy [on] March 19, CanisterWorm [on] March 20-22, Checkmarx [on] March 23, LiteLLM [on] March 24, Telnyx [on] March 27),&#8221; &#8230; <a href="https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/03/30/teampcp-supply-chain-attacks-ransomware/" rel="nofollow">More <span class="meta-nav">&#8594;</span></a></p> <p>The post <a href="https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/03/30/teampcp-supply-chain-attacks-ransomware/">TeamPCP’s attack spree slows, but threat escalates with ransomware pivot</a> appeared first on <a href="https://www.helpnetsecurity.com">Help Net Security</a>.</p>
